entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from network to UE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where extended protocol configuration options is not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Local IP address in TFT supported
entities.description: Condition where network supports Local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter, and PDN Type is different from Non-IP and Ethernet.

entities.name: Protocol data transmission to UE
entities.description: Network transmits protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the UE.

relations.description: Protocol configuration options IE is included when extended protocol configuration options is not supported.
Protocol configuration options IE shall be included if network supports Local IP address in TFT and PDN Type is different from Non-IP and Ethernet.
When extended protocol configuration options is not supported, network transmits protocol data to UE using protocol configuration options IE.
